payload.detail: OWNER RULING 2026-09-25: keep this guideline excluded from the medication clozapine WA reference panel (PR #3019 sources that panel from the WA Health statewide documents only). The question about this document in the search corpus stays open as below. REVIEW 2026-09-25 (offline audit of current main; no provider access): Now also the canonical home for the RKPG ANC/WBC label check formerly listed as action 2 of closed #SCYQAE. PRIOR DETAIL: CLINICAL GOVERNANCE, NOT A SOFTWARE DEFECT, and it is the reason the extraction fix alone does not close this out. ANALYSIS 2026-09-16 from live public-corpus evidence. The served chunk of Clozapine Therapy - Initiation, Continuation and Ceasing Policy and Procedure (RKPG).pdf p16 states 'Neutropenia ... WBC < 1.5 x 10 9/L' and 'Agranulocytosis ... WBC < 0.5 x 10 9/L'. Those are ANC figures. Australian practice: ANC below 1.5 x10^9/L is the red result requiring cessation, ANC below 0.5 defines agranulocytosis, and the WBC red threshold is 3.0 with green at WBC at or above 3.5 and ANC at or above 2.0. WHY THIS IS PROBABLY THE DOCUMENT AND NOT OUR PIPELINE, which is the whole point of this row: the line-major interleaving fixed in extract_pdf_assets splices whole LINES between columns, so it can move a line to the wrong place but it can never rewrite a word or split within a line. In the live text the run 'WBC < 1.5 x 10 9/L. Flu-like symptoms such' appears uninterrupted, bounded by 'Contact' before it and '3.2%' after it, both of which are fragments from other columns. That makes it a single source line from a single cell, so the label WBC and the value 1.5 were adjacent in the PDF itself. CORROBORATION from three other WA guidelines in the same corpus, extracted by the same pipeline: Clozapine Prescribing (NMHS) gives neutrophils at or above 2.0 and WBC at or above 3.5; Clozapine Prescribing, Administration and Monitoring (AKG) gives WBC at or above 3.5; Clozapine Therapy - Initiation and Continuation (FSH) gives neutrophils above 2.0, WBC above 3.5 and WBC below 3.0. Every one of them pairs WBC with 3.0 or 3.5 and neutrophils with 2.0. NONE pairs WBC with 1.5. RKPG is the outlier. CONFIDENCE: high, not certain. This is reasoning from extracted text of a document nobody on this side has opened. A clinician must read the source PDF before anything is escalated. NEXT STEPS: (1) read RKPG p16 in the original; (2) if it does say WBC below 1.5, raise it with Rockingham Peel Group as a clinical document error, because clinicians are reading that PDF directly and independently of this system; (3) only then decide what this knowledge base should do about the document, options being flag it, supersede it, or restrict it. DO NOT hand-edit corpus text to correct a source document. DO NOT relax the clozapine eval cases. The system refusing to answer clozapine threshold questions from this passage is the correct and protective behaviour, and it stays correct even after the re-index if the underlying document is genuinely wrong.
